'''Arbeloa's father''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Parent/Legends|parent]] of [[Arbeloa]]. He died sometime before the [[Battle of Vonak]]. Upon his death, Arbeloa fled to a forest to avoid dealing with the loss of his father.
